title: Returning Buyer Discount on the Homesite Reservation Reinstatement Fee
content:
**Rate card.** The reinstatement lender discount on the reinstatement fee of an expired Homesite Reservation hold is set by the buyer's earlier Calloway Home Purchase Agreement that stands closed, read from its financing type.

| Buyer's earlier Calloway Home Purchase Agreement | Reinstatement lender discount |
|---|---|
| stands closed with financing type Calloway Home Mortgage | 40 percent |
| stands closed with financing type outside lender or cash | 15 percent |
| no closed Calloway Home Purchase Agreement | nothing |

## Record cases (hypothetical buyers)

| Home Purchase Agreement record | Discount |
|---|---|
| closed, Calloway Home Mortgage | 40 percent |
| closed, outside lender | 15 percent |
| closed, cash | 15 percent |
| cancelled, Calloway Home Mortgage | nothing (the agreement does not stand closed) |
| none on the buyer's profile | nothing |
